technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals, but severe downtrend structure (death cross, below key MAs, bearish cloud) and weak momentum confirmation make this a high-risk bounce play rather than a reliable swing entry.

fundamental.summary: FAST shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 82 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31 Fear & Greed score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale and mixed with no recent conviction signals.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (371.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 82 days presents moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI conditions (9 and 14) with stochRSI cross-up and contrarian fear-zone sentiment (31 Fear & Greed) create a classic bounce setup in a panic-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe downtrend structure (EMA death cross, price below all key MAs, bearish Ichimoku cloud, no momentum confirmation via MACD/OBV/CMF) combined with zero fundamental conviction, high earnings risk in 82 days, and VIX crisis regime (371.2) make this a high-risk bounce trap rather than a reliable swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and stochRSI cross-up present a technical bounce setup in fear-zone sentiment, but severe downtrend structure (death cross, price below all key MAs, bearish cloud) and zero fundamental conviction make this a low-probability trade.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (371.2) combined with earnings event risk in 82 days creates elevated volatility that could extend the downtrend rather than trigger a reliable bounce.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents see bounce opportunity; fundamental and risk agents strongly reject due to lack of conviction and macro headwinds.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding FAST with 21 other Industrials positions (14.7% sector concentration); adding here increases concentration risk without fundamental or smart money support.
